# Implementation progress

Changes to the schema follow guidance from the GA4GH [Technical Specification Development](https://www.ga4gh.org/document/tasc-technical-specification-development/). As such, this [Saved Reply](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/working-with-saved-replies/creating-a-saved-reply) is used to track the progress of this feature modification or proposal.

## Progress

_Check each item as it is completed during the development process._

1. [ ] Discussed at a product meeting
2. [ ] Initial draft completed
3. [ ] Review period started and community notified
4. [ ] Pull request merged
5. [ ] Specification version incremented and release published
